depiction.primary_object: square document or list box with three horizontal lines
modifiers: circular clock badge in bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single bordered square with text lines, overlaid by a clock badge at bottom right

readings.meaning: timesheet, time log, or work hours record

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic document, a calendar, or a scheduled post/note icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: time tracking, schedule, history, or pending status

reasoning: Shows a lined document or list box combined with a clock badge, which naturally represents a timesheet, schedule, agenda, or activity log. It fits well for common work and personal tasks like logging hours, writing itineraries, or checking logs, though it overlaps somewhat with calendar and generic document icons.
